references.text: This prophecy in Zechariah is the direct source of the quote in John, where the king is described as humble and riding on a donkey.
The Hallel text in Psalms contains the cry for salvation and the recognition of the one who comes in the Lord's name, which the people also shout in John.
Isaiah urges Daughter Zion to rejoice over the coming of her king, a motif that is resumed with 'do not be afraid' in John.
Matthew quotes the same prophecy from Zechariah to confirm that Jesus' entry into Jerusalem was a fulfillment of Scripture.
Mark recounts the same event where Jesus enters Jerusalem on a donkey, affirming his royal status.
Luke records the people shouting 'Blessed is the king who comes in the Lord's name,' directly linked to the quote in John.
